summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the engine-free plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and thin ignite adapters for the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers. Updated the nifti_writer default dtype, the three in-repo output_path callers (now output_dir), and the classification test (passes filename). Added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Nothing was run: tests, installs, and repo code execution were out of bounds. Flake8 is not installed, so lint was checked by hand (line length 120, comma spacing, trailing newlines), and all passed. Open items: the tests are unverified; the EventAccumulator-based plot tests are the least certain; docs/source/data.rst does not list the new modules; no commits were made.
